reason: The README identifies this repository as a personal DeepSeek Harness plugin collection and development template, with maintained plugins, third-party integrations, and presets; plugin-development is the best primary category, while included runtime injection and host file, shell, Git, and browser capabilities warrant R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的个人插件合集，提供会话切换、研究项目面板、视觉工具、记忆、文件与终端等可选扩展。
summaries.en: A personal plugin collection for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, offering optional extensions for session switching, research projects, visual tools, memory, files, and terminal workflows.

capabilities: Installs and bundles multiple DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugins
Adds keyboard-driven session switching and layout controls
Scans workspaces and exposes project information
Provides runtime plugin injection, hot reload, rollback, and arbitrary in-process plugin execution
Provides file access, editing, terminal, Git, browser, and task panels through a sidebar
Provides agent-team coordination, memory persistence, visual/OCR tools, and conversation image export
